summary: Backend engineering leader with 11+ years of experience designing and building high-scale distributed systems for FinTech and banking platforms. Specialized in Node.js, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, AWS and event-driven architectures, with strong expertise in system design, API development, caching, observability, and production reliability.
